title: Grumpy Old Men
description: Minnesota neighbors (Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau) rekindle a 10-year feud when they fall for the same widow (Ann-Margret).

title: Grumpier Old Men
description: The wedding of their children and the arrival of a romantic prospect preoccupies bickering Minnesota retirees John (Jack Lemmon) and Max (Walter Matthau).

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E16 — Ephemera
The team tries to piece together how a retired Navy officer obtained a rare and valuable coin.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E17 — In a Nutshell
A Navy officer is murdered the same way his parents were murdered a decade ago; the team stumbles across a storage container filled with dollhouses that display re-creations of murder scenes; the team members agree to clean out their living spaces.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E18 — Schooled
The body of a well-regarded Navy technician is found floating in a lake, which isn't far from where a popular community event takes place; Sloane's daughter makes an unexpected request.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E19 — Blarney
When Kasie and Jimmy are held hostage in a diner after a jewelry store robbery goes awry, they attempt to keep the other customers safe from the thieves.

title: NCIS
description:
S17 E20 — The Arizona
The team tries to verify the identity of Joe Smith, who claims he served on the U.S.S. Arizona during the attack on Pearl Harbor and wants to be buried there upon his death.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E01 — Sturgeon Season
Gibbs and Fornell attempt to track down the leader of a drug ring who supplied drugs to Fornell's daughter; the team deals with the case of a missing cadaver from the NCIS autopsy room.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E04 — Crossfire
As the body count continues to rise, Maggie Bell and OA Zidan rush to track down an active sniper who has an elusive motive.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E05 — Doomsday
Maggie and OA investigate the death of a safety inspector and its possible connection to a leak at a nuclear power plant.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E06 — Family Man
After a senator's daughter is kidnapped and held for ransom, the FBI must find the little girl before their time limit expires; they must dig into the senator's past for clues to who did this to his family.

title: Practical Magic
description: Raised by their aunts, two sisters born into a magical family use different means to avoid a family legacy of witchcraft.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: Selena
description: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E03 — One of Our Own
Pride and the team take on a group of dirty cops when they discover that a murder victim was also a key witness in multiple excessive force cases; Tammy faces the reality of being in a new relationship.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E04 — We All Fall...
The team continue to investigate the murder of an officer who was about to blow the whistle on police misconduct; Pride must get creative in order to finally get rid of the dirty cops; the mayor asks Pride to join her new task force.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E05 — Operation Drano, Part I
The team investigates a suspicious death and the missing key piece of evidence is a top secret, high-tech battery; Pride and the team realize there could be deadly consequences if it falls into the wrong hands.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E06 — Operation Drano, Part II
When a torpedo hits a fishing trawler at sea, the entire Gulf Coast is in jeopardy as Pride and NCIS race to find the submarine before it can strike again.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E07 — Leda and the Swan, Part I
A Navy therapist who is working to get justice for victims of sexual assault is murdered; Carter's mother confronts him when he refuses to talk to the FBI for a background check on her behalf.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E08 — Leda and the Swan, Part II
As Pride and the team continue the investigation of an officer's assault and the murder of her therapist, NCIS zeroes in on a suspect who's been working the system for years; Carter and his mother talk about how they'll move forward after a mistake.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E02 — Everything Starts Somewhere
Flashbacks reveal the murder case that first introduced young Gibbs to NCIS and to Ducky.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E03 — Blood and Treasure
The discovery of two dead bodies in a forest leads the NCIS team into the wild world of modern-day treasure hunting; Gibbs and Fornell get deeper into their search for the opioid kingpin.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E04 — Sunburn
McGee and his wife Delilah's Bahamian vacation turns into a high-stakes mission; Gibbs fears the worst when his search for Fornell leads to blood.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E06 — 1mm
Following a tip about smuggled weapons, Bishop and Torres engage in a shootout in a former sheriff's residence that's now a historical site, only to find themselves locked in abandoned jail cells there.

title: NCIS
description:
S18 E07 — The First Day
NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer who was killed while driving home a recently released inmate; Gibbs helps Palmer deal with a personal trauma.

title: NCIS
description:
S07 E04 — Good Cop, Bad Cop
When a Marine's body surfaces halfway around the world, the investigation forces Ziva to dig up a lost chapter of her life.

title: NCIS
description:
S07 E05 — Code of Conduct
When a Marine known for his love of practical jokes is found dead on Halloween, the team is called in to investigate; they soon learn that his jokes may have been the reason why he was killed.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E01 — Spider and the Fly
Gibbs must take desperate measures to protect his loved ones with Paloma Reynosa still on the loose.

title: NCIS
description:
S08 E04 — Royals and Loyals
The team hopes to avoid an international incident when an American officer is killed on a British ship.

title: The Notebook
description: A man tells a story to a woman about two young people who become lovers in the 1940s North Carolina.

title: Selena
description: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E07 — Rusty
When the BAU team travels to Denver to investigate several murders, Prentiss is forced to evaluate her relationship with Special Agent Andrew Mendoza.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S15 E08 — Family Tree
Prentiss and J.J. are faced with important decisions to make about their futures as the BAU travels to Texas to investigate a series of murdered businessmen.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E09 — Into Thin Air
Pride and the team are on the hunt for a kidnapped 14-year-old and discover that her father, who will soon have custody of her, is a radical survivalist living off the grid.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E10 — Homeward Bound
When a petty officer is shot down by a sniper, Pride and NCIS hunt down the killer, only to find that he may not be acting alone; Rita tells Pride that she has been offered a compelling job.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E11 — Stashed
Sebastian's life is in danger when a criminal he put behind bars escapes police custody; Carter is tasked with keeping Sebastian in protective custody; Carter and Hannah's flirtation is fun gossip fodder for Tammy and Sebastian.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E12 — Once Upon a Time
After a Molotov cocktail is hurled into Pride's bar, evidence leads him to his old nemesis, Sasha Broussard; Tammy uses her profiling skills on Hannah and Carter with shocking accuracy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E13 — Choices
The team investigates the deadly bar bombing and impending criminal turf war involving Sasha Broussard; Pride must come to terms with having Connor in his life; Carter and Hannah work to define their new relationship.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E14 — Illusions
Pride directs the team to link Sasha to the recent attacks in New Orleans; Carter and Tammy search for a stolen highly trained military dog; Pride and Rita make an important decision about their wedding.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E15 — Runs in the Family
Pride and Rita plan their wedding; the FBI arrests Connor in connection to the bar's firebombing.

title: Law & Order
description:
S18 E14 — Burn Card
When a notorious hustler is found dead, Cyrus Lupo discovers that his partner, Ed Green, is the shooter; internal affairs takes over the case, forcing Green to reveal his troubled past.

title: Law & Order
description:
S18 E15 — Bogeyman
Detectives Cyrus Lupo and Kevin Bernard have reason to believe a cult is involved when a novelist is found dead in her car; Assistant District Attorney Michael Cutter has trouble prosecuting when several jury members fear for their own safety.

title: Law & Order
description:
S18 E16 — Strike
When a legal aid striker is killed outside the courthouse, the sand in his wounds leads detectives to investigate a greensman; due to the strike and shortage of defense attorneys, Rubirosa and Cutter must face each other in court.

title: Law & Order
description:
S18 E17 — Personae Non Grata
The murder of an automobile mechanic leads detectives to uncover a fraudulent online relationship, a bizarre case of blackmail and money laundering.

title: Law & Order
description:
S18 E18 — Excalibur
The murder of a jeweler leads detectives to an illegal prostitution ring; Jack McCoy's job is threatened.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E01 — Rumble
The beating death of a stockbroker causes a battle of epic proportions between the victim's family and the faction responsible for his death.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E02 — Challenged
A mentally challenged man is reunited with his mother, who gave him away after his brother was killed.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E03 — Lost Boys
A young woman (guest star Jena Malone) escapes from a polygamous cult.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E04 — Falling
A crane collapse kills a man, and it may not have been an accident; a rift forms between Jack McCoy and Michael Cutter.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E05 — Knock Off
A revered sheriff becomes a possible conspirator in a case involving a murdered tourist.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E06 — Sweetie
Detectives Lupo and Bernard investigate when the writer of a best-selling memoir is found dead in a community of male prostitutes.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E07 — Zero
Cutter is determined to expose misconduct when he realizes an old friend working in the system is obstructing justice in the murder of an environmentalist.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E08 — Chattel
While investigating the murder of two divorce lawyers, detectives Lupo and Bernard uncover a child slave-trade ring.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E09 — By Perjury
The murder of the plaintiff in a high-profile lawsuit against a major airline leads detectives to a defense attorney (Dallas Roberts) who is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure his big payday.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E10 — Pledge
When the son and housekeeper of a pair of prominent biologists are murdered, detectives suspect the couple's work on a controversial pharmaceutical study may have made them targets for the killer.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E11 — Lucky Stiff
The owner of a trucking company, Vic Russell, is found dead after a business meeting; detectives uncover information that leads them to believe that Russell had ties to the Russian mob.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E12 — Illegitimate
An NYPD officer kills a troubled fellow officer who took hostages at gunpoint; detectives Lupo and Bernard find valuable stolen documents and a dead body at the man's apartment.

title: Law & Order
description:
S19 E13 — Crimebusters
An unconscious war widow and her lifeless infant are found in the rubble of a bombed Army recruitment center; DA Jack McCoy must make one of the most-unpopular decisions of his career.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E07 — Cops and Robbers
Maggie and OA hunt down a ruthless group of robbers who are posing as police officers to target armored trucks.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E08 — This Land Is Your Land
Maggie and OA lead the search for an abducted former biological weapons chemist.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E09 — Compromised
After a key witness and a U.S. marshal are ambushed and killed, Maggie and OA must find the man who leaked the information that led to their murders.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E11 — Identity Crisis
When a judge and her daughter are murdered after she sentences a man to life in prison, Maggie and OA search for the killer; Dana has a history with the victim and a vested interest in the case.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E12 — A New Dawn
When an alt-right provocateur is murdered after giving a speech at a university in New York City, Maggie and OA investigate the school's more extreme political groups and rely on OA's sister, a student, for help.

title: FBI
description:
S01 E13 — Partners in Crime
Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E08 — Faire Is Foul
Team Scorpion visits a renaissance festival, but the revelry is cut short when a group tries to rob a nearby police evidence locker; Paige grows weary of Walter pointing out the historical inaccuracies at the festival.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E09 — It's Raining Men (of War)
Team Scorpion becomes stranded on a floating island of trash they were trying to destroy; Toby works with Cabe to uncover the details of his father's death.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E10 — Crime Every Mountain
Team Scorpion tries to help a father and his daughter when their plane crashes nearby; Paige helps Walter navigate his feelings about Cabe's possible future in prison.

title: NCIS
description:
S09 E01 — Nature of the Beast
After a firefight and a concussion wreak havoc on Tony's mind, Tony needs Gibbs to help him regain his memories of the investigation.

title: NCIS
description:
S10 E01 — Extreme Prejudice
Following the bombing of NCIS headquarters, the team engages in a cross-agency manhunt for Harper Dearing.
